bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
count="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -Atc "select count(*) from posting_topics where purpose='\''video_sale'\'' and chat_id=-1002373696859 and enabled and verified_by is not null;"')"
test "$count" = 0 || exit 70
match="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -Atc "select count(*) from posting_topics where chat_id=-1002373696859 and (title ilike '\''%稼げる%'\'' or title ilike '\''%有料動画%'\'');"')"
test "$match" = 0 || exit 71
echo VIDEO_SALE_UNBOUND_AND_NO_TITLE_MATCH=PASS
